description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score across three different data categories—“Regular members,” “Members with near-duplicates,” and “Held-out data”—as a function of the number of epochs. The x-axis, labeled “Epochs,” ranges from 0.0 to 3.0 in linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU score,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.35 in linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.10. The “Regular members” line is dark blue, marked with circles, and remains relatively flat, starting at approximately 0.01 and ending at approximately 0.07. The “Members with near-duplicates” line is orange, marked with triangles, and shows a steep, non-linear increase, starting at approximately 0.01, rising to a peak of approximately 0.35 at epoch 2.5, and then slightly declining to approximately 0.36 at epoch 3.0. The “Held-out data” line is dark green, marked with squares, and remains low and relatively flat, starting at approximately 0.02, dipping to a minimum of approximately 0.01 at epoch 1.5, and ending at approximately 0.03.
